					<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>TiviOne Channel List | 79,000+ International Live Channels — SD to 8K</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Browse TiviOne's complete channel catalogue — 79,000+ live channels from USA, France, UK, Arabic, Africa, India and 190+ countries. SD, HD, FHD, 4K and 8K quality. Plus 249,000+ VOD titles."/>
  <meta name="keywords" content="TiviOne channel list, IPTV channels 2025, live TV worldwide, international channels, sports IPTV, movies IPTV, 4K IPTV channels, TiviOne IPTV"/>

  <meta property="og:url" content="https://tivione.app/channel/"/>
  <meta property="og:type" content="website"/>
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"ItemList","name":"TiviOne Channel List","description":"79,000+ international live TV channels and 249,000+ VOD titles","numberOfItems":79000,"url":"https://tivione.app/channel/"}
  </script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;1,9..40,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css"/>
  <style>


    *,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    :root{
      --bg:#000000;--bg-2:#030305;--bg-3:#060610;
      --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--border-hi:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
      --text:#F5F2FF;--muted:#9490B0;--soft:#CCC8E2;
      --cyan:#40CFFF;--blue:#557EFF;--violet:#7B5CFF;--pink:#F040C8;--rose:#FF4F82;
      --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#38D0FF 0%,#8040E0 40%,#F030C8 75%,#FF6830 100%);
      --grad-soft:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.09),rgba(123,92,255,.11),rgba(240,64,200,.08));
      --r-xl:24px;--r-lg:18px;--r-md:12px;--r-sm:8px;--r-pill:999px;
      --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);--t:.28s var(--ease);
      --shadow-xl:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.55);--shadow-lg:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
    }
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
    body{
      font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 8% 12%,rgba(64,207,255,.10) 0%,transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 38% at 90% 10%,rgba(240,64,200,.09) 0%,transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 55% 92%,rgba(123,92,255,.13) 0%,transparent 100%),
        linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg-2) 55%,var(--bg-3) 100%);
      min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
    @keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes shimmer{0%{left:-100%}100%{left:200%}}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    @keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
    @keyframes pulseGlow{0%,100%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.95)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)}}

    /* ══ NAVBAR ══ */
    .navbar{position:sticky;top:0;left:0;right:0;width:100%;height:60px;z-index:9999;background:rgba(4,4,12,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
    .navbar-inner{height:100%;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;}
    .nv-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-logo-icon{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(123,92,255,.30);}
    .nv-logo-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;line-height:1.1;}
    .nv-logo-name b{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .nv-logo-sub{font-size:.60rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;}
    .nv-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex:1;justify-content:center;}
    .nv-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .18s ease;white-space:nowrap;}
    .nv-links a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);}
    .nv-links a.active{color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(64,207,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.18);}
    .nv-links svg{width:13px;height:13px;opacity:.6;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;}
    .nv-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:34px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:7px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s ease;}
    .nv-btn-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.15);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.25);color:#4ade80;cursor:pointer;}
    .nv-btn-wa:hover{background:rgba(37,211,102,.22);color:#86efac;}
    .nv-btn-order{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(128,64,224,.30);}
    .nv-btn-order:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px);}
    .nv-ham{display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;min-width:36px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;padding:0;}
    .nv-ham-icon{width:18px;height:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none;}
    .nv-ham-line{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#fff;transition:all .25s ease;transform-origin:center;}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg);}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg);}
    .nv-drawer{position:fixed;top:60px;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(4,4,14,.99);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:12px 16px 16px;z-index:9998;transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease;}
    .nv-drawer.open{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;pointer-events:all;}
    .nv-drawer-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:12px;}
    .nv-drawer-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:9px;text-decoration:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.80);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;transition:all .18s ease;}
    .nv-drawer-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;}
    .nv-drawer-link.active{background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);color:var(--cyan);}
    .nv-drawer-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.6;}
    .nv-drawer-div{height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);margin:8px 0;}
    .nv-drawer-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}
    .nv-drawer-btn{height:42px;border-radius:9px;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s ease;}
    .nv-drawer-btn-wa{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#25D366,#128C7E);color:#fff;}
    .nv-drawer-btn-order{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;}
    @media(max-width:900px){.nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none;}.nv-ham{display:flex;}}

    /* ══ NAVBAR MOBILE FIX ══ */
    .navbar{background:rgba(4,4,12,.98)!important}
    .navbar-inner{padding:0 16px!important;gap:8px!important}
    .nv-ham{
      display:none;
      width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important;
      border-radius:8px!important;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;
      border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)!important;
      align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      flex-shrink:0!important;padding:0!important;
      cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s ease;
    }
    .nv-ham:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important}
    .nv-ham-icon{width:16px!important;height:12px!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}
    .nv-ham-line{display:block;width:100%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#ffffff!important;transition:all .25s ease;transform-origin:center}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(5px) rotate(45deg)}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(2){opacity:0;transform:scaleX(0)}
    .nv-ham.open .nv-ham-line:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg)}
    .nv-drawer{
      background:rgba(4,6,18,.99)!important;
      backdrop-filter:blur(24px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px)!important;
    }
    .nv-drawer-link{
      color:rgba(255,255,255,.80)!important;
      font-size:.92rem!important;
      padding:13px 14px!important;
      border:1px solid transparent;
    }
    .nv-drawer-link:hover{color:#fff!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important}
    .nv-drawer-link.active{color:var(--cyan)!important;background:rgba(64,207,255,.08)!important;border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.15)!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn{height:46px!important;font-size:.90rem!important;font-weight:700!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn-wa{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(37,211,102,.25)!important}
    .nv-drawer-btn-order{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(123,92,255,.28)!important}
    @media(max-width:900px){
      .nv-links,.nv-btn-wa{display:none!important}
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:600px){
      .nv-ham{display:flex!important}
      .nv-logo-sub{display:none!important}
      .nv-btn-order{padding:0 10px!important;font-size:.74rem!important;height:30px!important}
      .navbar-inner{padding:0 12px!important}
    }
    @media(max-width:380px){
      .nv-logo-name{font-size:.82rem!important}
      .nv-logo-icon{width:28px!important;height:28px!important}
    }

    /* ══ OFFICIAL BAR FIX ══ */
      width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;
      background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;
      color:#fff;font-size:.55rem;flex-shrink:0;
      box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(123,92,255,.35);
    }
      font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;
      letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
      background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    @media(min-width:640px){.official-bar-sep-hide{display:block}}
    @media(max-width:480px){
    }

    /* ══ GLOBAL MOBILE FIXES ══ */
    @media(max-width:600px){
      /* Modal */
      .modal-overlay{padding:8px!important}
      .modal{border-radius:16px!important;max-height:96vh!important}
      .modal-head{padding:16px 16px 12px!important}
      .modal-body{padding:14px!important}
      .payment-grid{gap:5px!important}
      .contact-choice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
      .contact-btn-badge{display:none!important}
      .form-input,.form-select{height:42px!important;font-size:.85rem!important}
    }

    @media(max-width:460px){.navbar-inner{padding:0 14px;}.nv-logo-sub{font-size:.52rem;}.nv-logo-icon{width:28px;height:28px;}.nv-logo-name{font-size:.88rem;}}

    /* ══ PAGE HERO ══ */
    .page-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;padding:72px 6% 80px;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;}
    .page-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:38px 38px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.6),transparent 100%);}
    .hero-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:900px;height:500px;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(123,92,255,.18) 0%,rgba(240,64,200,.11) 45%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(40px);}
    .page-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.20);color:rgba(150,225,255,.90);font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:24px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .05s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-eyebrow-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2.2s infinite;}
    .page-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .12s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-title .plain{color:var(--text);}
    .page-title .grad{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .page-sub{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.82;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;max-width:52ch;margin:0 auto 36px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .20s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);opacity:0;animation:up .5s .26s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .page-breadcrumb a{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;}
    .page-breadcrumb i{font-size:.65rem;opacity:.5;}

    /* ══ TRUST BAR ══ */
    .trust-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px 20px;margin-top:32px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .32s var(--ease) forwards;}
    .trust-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 15px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--soft);}
    .trust-pill i{font-size:.75rem;}

    /* ══ APPS SECTION ══ */
    .apps-section{padding:0 6% 100px;position:relative;}
    .apps-wrap{max-width:1300px;margin:0 auto;}

    /* Section label */
    .section-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:32px;}
    .section-label-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent);}
    .section-label-line.right{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.10));}
    .section-label-text{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;}

    /* ══ APP CARDS GRID ══ */
    .apps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;margin-bottom:72px;}

    .app-card{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      overflow:hidden;
      transition:all .35s var(--ease);
      opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .5s var(--ease) forwards;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    }
    .app-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s}
    .app-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.10s}
    .app-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.15s}
    .app-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.20s}
    .app-card:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.25s}
    .app-card:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.30s}
    .app-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--border-hi);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}

    /* Card header band */
    .app-card-band{
      padding:28px 24px 24px;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
      display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;
    }
    .app-card-band::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--band-grad,var(--grad-soft));opacity:.7;}
    .app-card-band-glow{position:absolute;top:-20%;right:-10%;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--band-color,rgba(123,92,255,.25)),transparent 65%);filter:blur(20px);pointer-events:none;animation:pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;}

    /* App icon */
    .app-icon{
      width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;
      display:grid;place-items:center;
      flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;
      box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .app-card:nth-child(2) .app-icon{animation-delay:.8s}
    .app-card:nth-child(3) .app-icon{animation-delay:1.6s}
    .app-card:nth-child(4) .app-icon{animation-delay:.4s}
    .app-card:nth-child(5) .app-icon{animation-delay:1.2s}
    .app-card:nth-child(6) .app-icon{animation-delay:2s}
    .app-icon svg,.app-icon i{font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;}

    .app-card-band-info{flex:1;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .app-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .app-tagline{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .app-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid;}

    /* Card body */
    .app-card-body{padding:20px 24px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}

    /* Info rows */
    .app-info-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
    .app-info-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);}
    .app-info-row-icon{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);width:14px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;}
    .app-info-row-content{flex:1;min-width:0;}
    .app-info-label{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px;}
    .app-info-val{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--soft);font-family:'DM Mono',monospace,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
    .copy-btn{
      width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:var(--muted);
      display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.72rem;flex-shrink:0;
      transition:all .2s ease;
    }
    .copy-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;}
    .copy-btn.ok{background:rgba(52,211,153,.15);color:#34d399;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.25);}

    /* Compatibility tags */
    .app-compat{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;}
    .compat-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;}
    .compat-tag i{font-size:.6rem;}

    /* Download button */
    .app-dl-btn{
      width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:var(--r-md);
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
      text-decoration:none;color:#fff;
      font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;
      letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
      transition:all .3s ease;margin-top:auto;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .app-dl-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,0);transition:background .3s ease;}
    .app-dl-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.10);}
    .app-dl-btn:hover::after{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);}

    /* ══ DOWNLOADER GUIDE ══ */
    .guide-section{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);
      background:var(--grad-soft);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding:40px 40px 36px;
      margin-bottom:72px;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .guide-section::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5%;top:-20%;width:400px;height:400px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(64,207,255,.10),transparent 65%);filter:blur(40px);pointer-events:none;}
    .guide-head{margin-bottom:32px;}
    .guide-eyebrow{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
    .guide-eyebrow-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--cyan);}
    .guide-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
    .guide-title em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .guide-sub{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.7;max-width:52ch;}
    .guide-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .guide-step{padding:20px 18px;border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);position:relative;}
    .step-num{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:700;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;line-height:1;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .step-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px;}
    .step-desc{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;}
    .step-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(64,207,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.18);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--cyan);font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:12px;}

    /* ══ DEVICES SECTION ══ */
    .devices-section{margin-bottom:72px;}
    .devices-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:16px;}
    .device-card{padding:22px 10px 18px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center;transition:all .32s var(--ease);position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:default;}
    .device-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--grad-soft);opacity:0;transition:opacity .32s ease;}
    .device-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.30);}
    .device-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
    .device-icon{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .32s ease;}
    .device-card:hover .device-icon{transform:scale(1.08) translateY(-2px);}
    .device-icon svg{display:block;flex-shrink:0;}
    .device-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.03em;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .device-sub{font-size:.60rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3;position:relative;z-index:1;}

    /* ══ CTA BAND ══ */
    .cta-band{
      border-radius:var(--r-xl);
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.08),rgba(123,92,255,.10),rgba(240,64,200,.07));
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
      padding:48px;
      text-align:center;
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .cta-band::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:600px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(123,92,255,.15),transparent 65%);filter:blur(40px);pointer-events:none;}
    .cta-band-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,2.4rem);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px;position:relative;}
    .cta-band-title em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .cta-band-sub{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.7;max-width:48ch;margin:0 auto 28px;position:relative;}
    .cta-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
    .cta-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;height:52px;padding:0 28px;border-radius:var(--r-md);text-decoration:none;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:all .3s ease;}
    .cta-btn-primary{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(123,92,255,.28);}
    .cta-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(240,64,200,.28);}
    .cta-btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--soft);}
    .cta-btn-ghost:hover{border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.30);background:rgba(64,207,255,.07);color:var(--cyan);}

    /* ══ FOOTER ══ */
    .site-footer{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-3),#050812);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:64px 5% 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-top:100px;}
    .footer-glow{position:absolute;left:20%;top:-10%;width:700px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(123,92,255,.08),transparent 65%);filter:blur(50px);pointer-events:none;}
    .footer-wrap{max-width:1300px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;}
    .footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:60px;padding-bottom:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);align-items:flex-start;}
    .footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;}
    .footer-brand-icon{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(123,92,255,.25);}
    .footer-brand-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px;}
    .footer-brand-name span{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
    .footer-brand-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:26ch;line-height:1.5;}
    .footer-contact-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
    .footer-contact-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s ease;letter-spacing:.02em;}
    .footer-wa{background:rgba(37,211,102,.10);border:1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.22);color:#6ee7b7;}
    .footer-wa:hover{background:rgba(37,211,102,.18);border-color:rgba(37,211,102,.40);}
    .footer-em{background:rgba(123,92,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.22);color:#c4b5fd;}
    .footer-em:hover{background:rgba(123,92,255,.18);border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.40);}
    .footer-links-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;}
    .footer-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
    .footer-col-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--soft);margin-bottom:4px;}
    .footer-link{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
    .footer-link:hover{color:var(--cyan);}
    .footer-bottom{padding:20px 0 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
    .footer-copy{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;}
    .footer-bottom-links{display:flex;gap:18px;}
    .footer-bottom-link{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s ease;}
    .footer-bottom-link:hover{color:var(--soft);}

    /* ══ RESPONSIVE ══ */
    @media(max-width:1100px){.apps-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.guide-steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.devices-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}.footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;}}
    @media(max-width:820px){.apps-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.devices-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}.guide-section{padding:28px 24px;}.cta-band{padding:36px 24px;}.footer-links-group{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
    @media(max-width:580px){.apps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.guide-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.devices-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.apps-section{padding:0 5% 72px;}.footer-links-group{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.footer-bottom{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}.footer-bottom-links{gap:12px;}.cta-btns{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;}.cta-btn{justify-content:center;}}
  
    /* ══ NAV LOGO IMAGE ══ */
    .nv-logo-img{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;display:block;background:transparent;}
  

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   CHANNEL PAGE — SPECIFIC STYLES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
  --bg:#000;--bg-2:#030305;--bg-3:#060610;
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.038);--border:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--border-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --text:#F5F2FF;--muted:#9490B0;--soft:#CCC8E2;
  --cyan:#40CFFF;--violet:#7B5CFF;--pink:#F040C8;
  --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#38D0FF 0%,#8040E0 40%,#F030C8 75%,#FF6830 100%);
  --grad-soft:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.09),rgba(123,92,255,.11),rgba(240,64,200,.08));
  --r-xl:24px;--r-lg:18px;--r-md:12px;--r-pill:999px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  --nav-h:60px;
}
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 8% 12%,rgba(64,207,255,.10) 0%,transparent 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 38% at 90% 10%,rgba(240,64,200,.09) 0%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg-2) 55%,var(--bg-3) 100%);min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* ── PAGE HERO ── */
.ch-hero{
  padding:64px 5% 60px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055);
}
.ch-hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:38px 38px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.4),transparent 100%);
}
.ch-hero-glow{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-5%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:700px;height:380px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,rgba(123,92,255,.12),rgba(64,207,255,.05) 50%,transparent 75%);
  filter:blur(48px);
}
.ch-hero-inner{
  max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;
  text-align:center;
}
.ch-hero-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.ch-hero-dot{
  width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--cyan);
  animation:blink 2s infinite;
}
/* Title — white base + one gradient word only */
.ch-hero-title{
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
  font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5.5vw,4.4rem);font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  line-height:1.02;margin-bottom:18px;color:#fff;
  opacity:0;animation:up .5s .06s var(--ease) forwards;
}
.ch-hero-title .t-plain{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.ch-hero-title .t-accent{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#40CFFF,#7B5CFF);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.ch-hero-sub{
  font-size:.97rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;
  max-width:50ch;margin:0 auto 34px;letter-spacing:.01em;
  opacity:0;animation:up .5s .16s var(--ease) forwards;
}

/* ── STATS — clean card strip ── */
.ch-stats{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:stretch;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;
  margin-bottom:38px;
  opacity:0;animation:up .5s .24s var(--ease) forwards;
}
.ch-stat{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;
  padding:18px 30px;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  transition:background .2s ease;
}
.ch-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.ch-stat:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.ch-stat-n{
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.65rem;font-weight:700;
  color:#fff;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
.ch-stat-l{
  font-size:.58rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}

/* ── SEARCH BAR — refined ── */
.ch-search-wrap{
  max-width:580px;margin:0 auto;
  opacity:0;animation:up .5s .32s var(--ease) forwards;
}
.ch-search-box{
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  border-radius:14px;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .22s ease,background .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease;
}
.ch-search-box:focus-within{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.20);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
.ch-search-icon{
  padding:0 18px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.30);font-size:.88rem;flex-shrink:0;
}
.ch-search-input{
  flex:1;height:52px;
  background:transparent!important;
  border:none;
  color:#fff;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:400;
  outline:none;
  -webkit-appearance:none;
  /* Prevent iOS auto-fill white background */
  -webkit-text-fill-color:#fff;
}
.ch-search-input:-webkit-autofill,
.ch-search-input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
.ch-search-input:-webkit-autofill:focus{
  -webkit-box-shadow:0 0 0 1000px rgba(10,12,28,.95) inset!important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;
  caret-color:#fff;
}
.ch-search-input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);font-weight:300}
.ch-search-clear{
  height:52px;padding:0 18px;background:transparent;border:none;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.30);font-size:.78rem;cursor:pointer;
  transition:color .18s;display:none;flex-shrink:0;
}
.ch-search-clear:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.70)}
.ch-count-msg{
  margin-top:10px;font-size:.76rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.30);
  text-align:center;min-height:18px;
}

/* ── FILTER BAR — professional segmented control ── */
.ch-filters-wrap{
  position:sticky;top:var(--nav-h);z-index:100;
  background:rgba(4,5,14,.96);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
.ch-filters{
  max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;
  padding:0 5%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;
  overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  scrollbar-width:none;
}
.ch-filters::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ch-filter-btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  padding:14px 18px;
  font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.80rem;font-weight:500;
  cursor:pointer;
  border:none;background:transparent;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.40);
  white-space:nowrap;
  position:relative;
  transition:color .2s ease;
  letter-spacing:.01em;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.ch-filter-btn::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;bottom:0;left:50%;right:50%;
  height:2px;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
  background:var(--grad);
  transition:left .22s var(--ease),right .22s var(--ease);
}
.ch-filter-btn:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.70)}
.ch-filter-btn.active{color:#fff}
.ch-filter-btn.active::after{left:14px;right:14px}
.ch-filter-sep{
  width:1px;height:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  flex-shrink:0;margin:0 4px;
  align-self:center;
}

/* ── MAIN CONTENT ── */
.ch-main{
  max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;
  padding:36px 5% 80px;
}

/* ── COUNTRY SECTION ── */
.ch-country{
  margin-bottom:12px;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .25s ease;
}
.ch-country.open{border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.22)}
.ch-country-header{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  padding:18px 22px;
  cursor:pointer;user-select:none;
  transition:background .2s ease;
}
.ch-country-header:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.ch-country-flag{font-size:1.5rem;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;width:28px;text-align:center}
.ch-country-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ch-country-name{
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:2px;
}
.ch-country-desc{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ch-country-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0}
.ch-channel-count{
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;
  padding:4px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  background:rgba(64,207,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.15);color:var(--cyan);
}
.ch-country-arrow{
  font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);
  transition:transform .28s ease,color .2s ease;
}
.ch-country.open .ch-country-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--cyan)}
/* Channel grid inside */
.ch-body{
  max-height:0;overflow:hidden;
  transition:max-height .4s var(--ease);
}
.ch-country.open .ch-body{max-height:3000px}
.ch-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));
  gap:8px;padding:6px 22px 20px;
}
.ch-item{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:9px 13px;border-radius:10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  transition:all .2s ease;
  font-size:.78rem;color:var(--soft);
}
.ch-item:hover{background:rgba(64,207,255,.06);border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.18);color:#fff}
.ch-item-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);flex-shrink:0;opacity:.7}
.ch-item-name{flex:1;line-height:1.3;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ch-item-qual{
  font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;
  padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;letter-spacing:.04em;
}
.qual-4k{background:rgba(240,64,200,.15);color:#f0abfc}
.qual-hd{background:rgba(64,207,255,.12);color:#7dd3fc}
.qual-fhd{background:rgba(123,92,255,.12);color:#c4b5fd}
/* Empty result */
.ch-no-results{
  text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;
  display:none;
  color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;
}
.ch-no-results i{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:14px;display:block;color:var(--border-hi)}
/* CTA bar */
.ch-cta-bar{
  margin:0 5% 60px;
  padding:32px 36px;
  border-radius:24px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.08),rgba(123,92,255,.10),rgba(240,64,200,.07));
  border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.22);

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       CHANNEL PAGE V2 — EXTRA STYLES
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
    :root{
      --nav-h:60px;
      --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#38D0FF 0%,#8040E0 40%,#F030C8 75%,#FF6830 100%);
      --grad-soft:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.09),rgba(123,92,255,.11),rgba(240,64,200,.08));
      --muted:#9490B0;--soft:#CCC8E2;--text:#F5F2FF;
      --cyan:#40CFFF;--violet:#7B5CFF;--pink:#F040C8;
      --border:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--border-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.038);
      --r-lg:18px;--r-md:12px;--r-pill:999px;
      --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    *,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
    body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 8% 12%,rgba(64,207,255,.10) 0%,transparent 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 38% at 90% 10%,rgba(240,64,200,.09) 0%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(160deg,#000 0%,#030305 55%,#060610 100%);min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
    a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
    @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
    @keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
    @keyframes shimmer{0%{background-position:-200% center}100%{background-position:200% center}}

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .ch-hero{padding:56px 5% 52px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
    .ch-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:34px 34px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.5),transparent)}
    .ch-hero-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:800px;height:380px;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,rgba(123,92,255,.18),rgba(240,64,200,.10) 45%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(40px)}
    .ch-hero-inner{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center}
    .ch-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px}
    .ch-eyebrow-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--cyan);animation:blink 2s infinite}
    .ch-title{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.2rem);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:14px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .05s var(--ease) forwards}
    .ch-title em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
    .ch-sub{font-size:.97rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;max-width:52ch;margin:0 auto 28px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .15s var(--ease) forwards}
    /* Stats */
    .ch-stats{display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;margin:0 auto 32px;max-width:680px;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .22s var(--ease) forwards}
    .ch-stat{flex:1;padding:16px 20px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
    .ch-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
    .ch-stat:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
    .ch-stat-n{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1;margin-bottom:3px}
    .ch-stat-l{font-size:.60rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
    /* Search */
    .ch-search-wrap{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;opacity:0;animation:up .5s .28s var(--ease) forwards}
    .ch-search-box{display:flex;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r-pill);overflow:hidden;transition:all .2s ease}
    .ch-search-box:focus-within{border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.40);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(64,207,255,.10);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    .ch-search-icon{padding:0 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;flex-shrink:0}
    .ch-search-input{flex:1;height:50px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;outline:none}
    .ch-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
    .ch-search-clear{height:50px;padding:0 16px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s;display:none;flex-shrink:0}
    .ch-search-clear:hover{color:var(--text)}
    .ch-count-msg{margin-top:9px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;min-height:18px}

    /* ── FILTER BAR ── */
    .ch-filters{position:sticky;top:var(--nav-h);z-index:100;background:rgba(4,4,12,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:12px 5%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
    .ch-filters::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .ch-filter-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s ease;flex-shrink:0}
    .ch-filter-btn:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
    .ch-filter-btn.active{background:rgba(64,207,255,.12);border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.30);color:var(--cyan)}

    /* ── MAIN ── */
    .ch-main{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 5% 80px}

    /* ── COUNTRY ACCORDION ── */
    .ch-country{margin-bottom:10px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
    .ch-country:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
    .ch-country.open{border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.22);box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(64,207,255,.06)}
    .ch-country-header{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 22px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;text-align:left;transition:background .2s ease}
    .ch-country-header:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
    .ch-flag{font-size:1.55rem;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;width:30px;text-align:center}
    .ch-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
    .ch-name{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:2px}
    .ch-desc{font-size:.70rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .ch-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-shrink:0}
    .ch-count{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:var(--soft)}
    .ch-arrow{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .28s ease,color .2s ease}
    .ch-country.open .ch-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--cyan)}

    /* Quality badges */
    .ch-qual{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.60rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
    .q8k{background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(64,207,255,.20),rgba(240,64,200,.15));border:1px solid rgba(240,64,200,.30);color:#f0abfc}
    .q4k{background:rgba(240,64,200,.12);border:1px solid rgba(240,64,200,.25);color:#f9a8d4}
    .qfhd{background:rgba(123,92,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.28);color:#c4b5fd}
    .qhd{background:rgba(64,207,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(64,207,255,.22);color:#7dd3fc}
    .qsd{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:var(--muted)}

    /* Body accordion */
    .ch-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .45s var(--ease)}
    .ch-country.open .ch-body{max-height:9000px}

    /* Category label */
    .ch-cat-group{margin:0}
    .ch-cat-group:first-child .ch-cat-label{margin-top:4px}
    .ch-cat-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 22px 6px;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
    .ch-cat-group:first-child .ch-cat-label{border-top:none}
    .ch-cat-label i{font-size:.6rem;opacity:.7}

    /* Channel grid */
    .ch-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(195px,1fr));gap:6px;padding:4px 18px 14px}
    .ch-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);transition:all .18s ease;font-size:.77rem;color:var(--soft);cursor:default}
    .ch-item:hover{background:rgba(64,207,255,.06);border-color:rgba(64,207,255,.18);color:#fff}
    .ch-item-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(64,207,255,.60);flex-shrink:0}
    .ch-item-name{flex:1;line-height:1.3;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

    /* VOD items */
    .ch-grid-vod{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))}
    .vod-item{padding:9px 13px;border-radius:10px}
    .vod-item .ch-item-ico{font-size:.72rem;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.60;color:var(--cyan)}

    .vod-new:hover{background:rgba(240,64,200,.10);border-color:rgba(240,64,200,.30)}
    .vod-award{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.18);background:rgba(251,191,36,.04)}
    .vod-award:hover{background:rgba(251,191,36,.08);border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.30);color:#fde68a}
    .vod-series{border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.18);background:rgba(123,92,255,.04)}
    .vod-series:hover{background:rgba(123,92,255,.10);border-color:rgba(123,92,255,.30)}
    .vod-doc{border-color:rgba(52,211,153,.15);background:rgba(52,211,153,.04)}
    .vod-doc:hover{background:rgba(52,211,153,.08);border-color:rgba(52,211,153,.25);color:#6ee7b7}
    .vod-year{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:.56rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(240,64,200,.15);color:#f9a8d4;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:2px}

    /* No results */
    .ch-no-results{text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;display:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
    .ch-no-results i{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:12px;display:block;color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}

    /* CTA Bar */
    .ch-cta-bar{margin:8px 5% 60px;padding:30px 34px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(64,207,255,.08),rgba(123,92,255,.10),rgba(240,64,200,.07));border:1px solid rgba(123,92,255,.22);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .ch-cta-left h3{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:5px}

<script>
/* ══ AUTO YEAR ══ */
(function(){var y=new Date().getFullYear();document.querySelectorAll('.js-year').forEach(function(el){el.textContent=y;});})();

/* ══ NAVBAR ══ */
function toggleNav(){
  var d=document.getElementById('nvDrawer'),h=document.getElementById('nvHam');
  var o=d.classList.toggle('open');h.classList.toggle('open',o);
  h.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o?'true':'false');
  document.body.style.overflow=o?'hidden':'';
}
function closeNav(){
  var d=document.getElementById('nvDrawer'),h=document.getElementById('nvHam');
  d.classList.remove('open');h.classList.remove('open');
  h.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');document.body.style.overflow='';
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var d=document.getElementById('nvDrawer'),h=document.getElementById('nvHam');
  if(d&&h&&d.classList.contains('open')&&!d.contains(e.target)&&!h.contains(e.target))closeNav();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')closeNav();});

/* ══ ACCORDION ══ */
function toggleCountry(btn){
  var country=btn.closest('.ch-country');
  var wasOpen=country.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-country.open').forEach(function(c){
    c.classList.remove('open');
    c.querySelector('.ch-country-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  });
  if(!wasOpen){
    country.classList.add('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    setTimeout(function(){
      var r=btn.getBoundingClientRect(),nav=60;
      if(r.top<nav+8)window.scrollBy({top:r.top-nav-8,behavior:'smooth'});
    },50);
  }
}

/* ══ SEARCH ══ */
var _st;
document.getElementById('chSearch').addEventListener('input',function(){
  clearTimeout(_st);_st=setTimeout(doSearch,160);
});

function doSearch(){
  var q=document.getElementById('chSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var clear=document.getElementById('chClear');
  var msg=document.getElementById('chCountMsg');
  clear.style.display=q?'flex':'none';
  if(!q){resetView();return;}
  
  var total=0;
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-country').forEach(function(country){
    var cname=country.querySelector('.ch-name').textContent.toLowerCase();
    var cmatch=cname.includes(q);
    var items=country.querySelectorAll('.ch-item');
    var vis=0;
    items.forEach(function(item){
      var show=cmatch||((item.dataset.name||'').includes(q));
      item.style.display=show?'':'none';
      if(show)vis++;
    });
    var show=cmatch||vis>0;
    country.style.display=show?'':'none';
    if(show){
      total+=vis||items.length;
      if(!country.classList.contains('open')){
        country.classList.add('open');
        country.querySelector('.ch-country-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      }
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('chNoResults').style.display=total===0?'block':'none';
  msg.textContent=total>0?total+' results found':'';
}

function clearSearch(){
  document.getElementById('chSearch').value='';
  document.getElementById('chClear').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('chCountMsg').textContent='';
  resetView();
}

function resetView(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-country').forEach(function(c){
    c.style.display='';c.classList.remove('open');
    c.querySelector('.ch-country-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    c.querySelectorAll('.ch-item').forEach(function(i){i.style.display='';});
  });
  document.getElementById('chNoResults').style.display='none';
  var ab=document.querySelector('.ch-filter-btn.active');
  if(ab){var r=ab.getAttribute('data-region')||'all';applyFilter(r,ab.getAttribute('data-focus'));}
}

/* ══ REGION FILTER ══ */
var _activeRegion='all',_activeFocus=null;
function filterRegion(region,btn,focus){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-filter-btn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('active');});
  btn.classList.add('active');
  btn.setAttribute('data-region',region);
  btn.setAttribute('data-focus',focus||'');
  _activeRegion=region;_activeFocus=focus||null;
  var q=document.getElementById('chSearch').value.trim();
  if(!q)applyFilter(region,focus);
}
function applyFilter(region,focus){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-country').forEach(function(c){
    var cr=c.getAttribute('data-region');
    var id=c.getAttribute('data-id');
    var show;
    if(focus==='vod')show=(id==='vod');
    else show=(region==='all'||(cr===region||cr==='all'))&&id!=='vod'||id==='vod'&&region==='all';
    c.style.display=show?'':'none';
    if(show&&c.classList.contains('open')){c.classList.remove('open');c.querySelector('.ch-country-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}
  });
}

/* ══ SCROLL REVEAL ══ */
(function(){
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window))return;
  var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        e.target.style.opacity='1';e.target.style.transform='none';obs.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:0.04});
  document.querySelectorAll('.ch-country').forEach(function(el,i){
    el.style.opacity='0';el.style.transform='translateY(14px)';
    el.style.transition='opacity .38s ease '+((i%6)*.05)+'s, transform .38s ease '+((i%6)*.05)+'s';
    obs.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
